goal: Run unit tests on native macOS arm64 hardware using release-like cross-compiled binaries in CI
Catch macOS-specific runtime defects and crashes before release
agreement: Concept support to test cross-built release binaries natively like Windows does (fanquake)
Unanswered question on whether caching is faster than artifacts and if consistency matters (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it adds native CI execution for macOS cross-builds to catch platform bugs before release
Prevents platform-specific runtime regressions from shipping undetected

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it runs test suites on real macOS arm64 runners instead of relying only on Linux
Detects realistic platform-specific test failures that cannot be caught otherwise
